# NDE: NoirDemons — agent guide

## About
NDE: NoirDemons (formerly Novexa) is an independent intelligence studio. We build
intelligent systems for ideas, finance, analytics, education and the future of
development. Tagline: "Make the impossible useful." Contact:
nde.noirdemons@atomicmail.io

## Products (Top Public)
- Solve NCERT — Learning Systems. NCERT solutions for CBSE Class 9, fully AI-powered
  and human-verified, grown organically with zero promotion in less than 3 months.
  Search Console: 490 clicks, 5.43K impressions, 9% CTR, position 8.4.
- Novexa — Idea Platforms. Where raw ideas become testable before the world gets a vote.
- BlitzData — Data & Analytics. Raw data turned into a clear, defensible line of sight.
- EconoMind AI — Economic Intelligence. Macro signals decoded into decisions.

## Plans — buy the source code (one-time)
- Starter: ₹10,000/- — full handover, business website/landing system, forms,
  dashboards and CRUD flows, database integration, deployed to your hosting,
  handover session and documentation.
- Business: ₹20,000/- — advanced business apps, auth and roles, admin dashboards,
  API integrations, deployed to your infrastructure, 30 days support.
- Pro: ₹30,000/- — full-featured custom apps, complex dashboards, integrations and
  automation, multiple user roles, payments and third-party services,
  60 days support.
- Custom: Let's discuss — institutional systems, startup MVPs, custom SaaS
  products, specialised software.

## Plans — run it as a service (SaaS, monthly, all inclusive)
- Starter: ±₹2,000/mo — fully interactive landing page, forms/dashboards/CRUD,
  database integration, deployment, setup and documentation.
- Business: ±₹6,000/mo — advanced business apps, auth, dashboards, API
  integrations, automated workflows, deployment and configuration.
- Pro: ±₹10,000/mo — full-featured custom apps, complex dashboards,
  integrations and automation, multiple user roles, payments, production
  deployment and full support.
- Custom: Let's discuss — institutional systems, startup MVPs, custom SaaS
  products, highly specialised software, complex requirements.

## Why choose NDE (comparative study)
Own the source code: you own the code and data, you manage, debug, fix, change,
upgrade and hire; hosting, infrastructure, security and encryption are yours and
you pay; updates are charged after handover; new features scoped and charged
separately; no recurring payments to NDE (infrastructure/domain costs apply);
control is high but stressful; scalability is harder; no watermark.

SaaS (Run it as our service): we run everything — just tell us, no extra costs,
all included; hosting, database, security and breaches are on our renowned
partners and us, we pay; continuous updates and security updates included; bug
fixes included; new features roll into your plan (just drop us an email or DM);
one simple plan; control is lower and peaceful; scaling is seamless, hasslefree,
quick and practical; no watermark in any plan.
